changelog:
Testing Build (vc22-0910) vs Testing Build (vc23-1010)

Changes

- Update History now works with zero manual steps: the baseline entry seeds as soon as the server boots (and on first read), every read reconciles in-progress entries (done / failed / interrupted) and every Check refreshes the list.

- Images tab is instant: the Quick Deploy templates render as soon as they arrive while the full image scan (local scan + node queries) fills the image list in the background.

- Rename containers: Settings > General now has a Name field - enabled only while the container is stopped (blocked while running, this device only); the directory, config and any stack / backup-routine references follow the new name.

- Backups: removed the duplicate "Create Routine" button from the empty state - the header "Create" button is the single entry point.

- Modal X close buttons unified to the standard ghost button style (Create Container, Network, Stack and Backup modals).

- Update completion toast now reads "Android Konteiner has been successfully updated."
